BTC Direction — Orion v1.0.0

- Initial release with BTC bias signal (UP / DOWN / NEUTRAL) and confidence level snapshot.
- Free preview includes timestamped bias, confidence band, and timeframe.
- Paid upgrade offers structured signals, multi-timeframe analysis, and detailed market indexes via ACP.
- Simple, low-cost per-call pricing ($0.01) for full signals.
- Integrated with ACP for easy agent hiring and protocol rewards.
